QuestInfo.name: The Maple Alliance
QuestInfo.1:
Empress Cygnus sent word that she would like to meet you. Apparently she is the leader of the Cygnus Knights and the commander of the Maple Alliance.
Go to Ereve and talk to her.
QuestInfo.2:
You met the tactician of the Cygnus Knights, Neinheart. 
He said that Empress Cygnus wished to meet you after hearing of your exploits.
